This bugfix release lets Lumi accept a narrowly bounded kind of internal file symlink in repository directories. Lumi records the link target path as an inert stub; it does not follow or import the target as source. The link must use a canonical relative path to one regular file inside the supplied repository tree. External, chained, directory, broken, `.git`, mount, and other unsupported targets remain rejected.

It also includes the public Bandit SARIF walkthrough and clearer first-run output.

Lumi still starts with an existing finding. It ranks likely Python files and symbols for human review; it does not scan for vulnerabilities or decide whether a repository is safe.

Try the GitHub Action with synthetic or authorised input:
`uses: noqt/Lumi-Trace@v0.10.1`

Keep evidence private unless you're authorised to store it in GitHub.
